question: In which Olympics did Abhinav Bindra win the gold medal in Men’s 10 m air rifle shooting?
solution:
The correct answer is __Beijing 2008__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Abhinav Bindra is a retired sport shooter and he is also an Indian businessman.
 
• Bindra is India's first individual Olympic gold medalist.
 
• He won the gold medal in the 10-meter air rifle event at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
 
• Since 1980, It was also India's first Olympic gold medal.
 
• He won the Arjuna award in 2000.
 
• He was also awarded "Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna" in 2002 and "Padma Bhushan" in 2009.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Bindra is the first shooter to have held concurrently the world and Olympic titles for the men's 10-meter air rifle event and having earned those honors at the Summer Olympics 2008 and the ISSF World Shooting Championships 2006.
 
• He has also won 9 medals at the Commonwealth Games.
 
• Bindra also won 3 gold medals at the Asian Games.
